Augmental | Senior Software Engineer (Embedded/Full Stack) | San Francisco, CA US | full-time | ONSITE

Build in-mouth HID and other wearable HCI with us! We develop novel human-computer interaction devices, with a focus on assistive tech and AI interfaces. Our flagship product, the MouthPad^, is an intraoral wearable device that unlocks expressive computer control for people with severely limited hand mobility. Our upcoming product, a consumer wearable prototype, enables next-generation AI interactions while also empowering people with disabilities, continuing our mission to advance seamless, equitable access to the digital world.

Details and contact info at https://www.augmental.tech/join-us/software
